name: CeraVe Hydrating Cleanser For Normal To Dry Skin 236ml (Made in UK)
description:
Developed with dermatologists, CeraVe Hydrating Cleanser gently cleanses and hydrates normal to dry skin without disrupting the protective skin barrier. This non-foaming lotion, enriched with 3 essential ceramides and hyaluronic acid, removes dirt and oil while improving skin hydration from the very first use.

Key Features:

Gentle Cleansing & Hydration: Effectively cleanses while maintaining skin’s natural barrier.

Essential Ingredients: Contains 3 ceramides and hyaluronic acid to nourish and hydrate.

Fragrance-Free & Sensitive Skin Friendly: Safe for adults, children, and sensitive skin.

Versatile Use: Suitable for both face and body.

Dermatologist Tested: All CeraVe products undergo rigorous testing for safety and effectiveness.

Made in UK
